caption:
Six hunters and show-offs in fifteen seconds: a heron striking, a bee-eater with a dragonfly, a brown bear charging for salmon, a peacock turning his train, a leopard on the move and a kingfisher on watch.

Source: wild footage from Wikimedia Commons, credited below.

Which one was your favourite? Tell us in the comments, and follow for calmer, slower Reels too.
